header:
Note: Leave policy (Policy, people-ops)
Summary: Annual, sick, and parental leave entitlements for employees.
Themes: onboarding.
Section: Policy / Scope / Exceptions / Related
text:
# Policy

Employees get 20 days of annual leave, 10 days of paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of
parental leave.

# Scope

All employees. Contractors follow their contract.

# Exceptions

Unused annual leave above 5 days does not carry over.
